# A Quick Look at the Right Panel 👀

#### Course: Figma to Code

## A Quick Look at the Right Panel 👀

You're on the Figma design file now. Open the link, then click the Portfolio design.

![Portfolio design layout in Figma](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

Once you click it, look at the right panel. This is the panel you'll use throughout the course.

![A Quick Look at the Right Panel ](data:application/octet-stream;base64,)

This panel shows the details you'll translate into HTML and CSS later

- font size and line height when you select text
- width and height when you select a card or image
- spacing and layout values when you select a section

For this step, that's all. Click the Portfolio design and get familiar with the right panel.

Next, I'll show you how to select the exact text, button, or image you want without fighting the canvas.
